displaySummary.en: AI100 (2022-2023) · Algorithm discovery with reinforcement learning
displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 强化学习发现算法

displayDescription.en:
AlphaTensor represented matrix multiplication as a tensor-decomposition game and trained an AlphaZero-style agent to search for efficient sequences of rank-one updates. This converted a longstanding mathematical algorithm-design problem into a reinforcement-learning environment.

The system rediscovered known methods and found improved algorithms for several matrix sizes, including a finite-field result beyond the 1969 Strassen benchmark for 4 x 4 matrices. It demonstrated that learned search can contribute new algorithmic knowledge rather than only optimize an existing implementation.
displayDescription.zh:
AlphaTensor 把矩阵乘法表示为张量分解游戏，并训练类似 AlphaZero 的智能体搜索高效的秩一更新序列。这样，一个长期存在的数学算法设计问题被转化为强化学习环境。

系统既重新发现已知方法，也为若干矩阵规模找到改进算法，其中包括在有限域上超越 1969 年 Strassen 4 x 4 矩阵乘法结果的方法。它证明学习式搜索能够贡献新的算法知识，而不只是优化既有实现。

html.en: Matrix multiplication is a basic operation behind scientific computing and machine learning, yet finding algorithms with fewer scalar multiplications is a difficult combinatorial problem. Before AlphaTensor, major improvements were usually derived through sustained human mathematical work.
html.zh: 矩阵乘法是科学计算和机器学习的基础运算，但寻找更少标量乘法的算法是困难的组合问题。在 AlphaTensor 之前，重要改进通常来自长期的人类数学推导。

html.en: AlphaTensor encodes the multiplication tensor as a game state, where each move subtracts a rank-one tensor until the target is reduced to zero. A neural network and tree search learn to choose moves that produce short, valid decompositions.
html.zh: AlphaTensor 把乘法张量编码为游戏状态，每一步减去一个秩一张量，直到目标归零。神经网络与树搜索学习选择动作，从而产生短而有效的分解。

html.en: Experts generally treat AlphaTensor as a landmark for AI-assisted algorithm discovery because the output is an explicit, verifiable algorithm. It broadened the AlphaZero paradigm from board games to mathematical search and inspired later work on optimizing low-level computation.
html.zh: 专家通常把 AlphaTensor 视为 AI 辅助算法发现的里程碑，因为其输出是明确且可验证的算法。它把 AlphaZero 范式从棋类扩展到数学搜索，并推动了后续底层计算优化研究。
